newsitem.title: UK: EIB signs 5.0 billion Ecu debt issuance programme.
newsitem.headline: EIB signs 5.0 billion Ecu debt issuance programme.

text.p: The European Investment Bank has singed a 5.0 billion Ecu debt issuance programme, joint arrangers Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Goldman Sachs International said in statement on Friday.
The EIB's outstanding debt is rated triple-A by Standard and Poor's and Moody's, the statement said.
The programme will be open to reverse enquiry deals and contains a clause stipulating Ecu-denominated transactions will be exchanged into Euros at a fixed rate of one-to-one.
The programme will be governed by English and German law, with an option to use other jurisdictions, the statement said.
